title: Terms and conditions
scope: AFTER 0.5.0 is free, works offline and contains no ads or purchases. All available games and categories are unlocked.

sections.title: 1. Who provides AFTER
paragraphs: AFTER is a group game app provided by Fabián Del Castillo, based in Ecuador. Contact: fabijuegos10@gmail.com.
These terms govern the free version. You can read them before accepting and find them later in Settings. Declining them does not incur any charge.

sections.title: 2. Age and participation
paragraphs: AFTER is intended for people aged 16 and over. If you are a minor, you must have your legal representative’s permission when required by applicable law.
Each participant decides whether to play and may stop at any time. No result obliges anyone to perform an action. A kiss requires both people’s agreement at that moment.
Alcohol is not required. Do not use AFTER to pressure, harass, humiliate, discriminate against or endanger anyone. Use names or nicknames with the knowledge of the people they represent.

sections.title: 3. Use and availability
paragraphs: You may use the app for personal entertainment on compatible devices. You may not claim authorship or distribute modified copies as official versions of AFTER.
A feature marked Coming soon is not yet available. Sensor response and the number of fingers detected depend on the phone.
You can report errors to the contact email. Nothing in these terms excludes warranties, consumer rights or liabilities that cannot legally be limited.

sections.title: 4. Free access and future changes
paragraphs: This version has no ads, payments or subscriptions. No purchase is needed to choose a category. Mix includes all categories.
A future update may offer ads or optional purchases. You will be informed before they are enabled. This acceptance does not authorise future advertising, tracking, subscriptions or charges.

sections.title: 5. Privacy, records and rights
paragraphs: The privacy policy explains local data and how to delete it. Acceptance is saved only on this device, with the date, language, version and document hashes. It does not verify participants’ identities.
Material changes to the terms will require new acceptance. You can stop using AFTER and delete its data at any time.

For questions or complaints, email fabijuegos10@gmail.com. Mandatory rights in your country are respected. These terms do not impose mandatory arbitration or waive your right to contact competent authorities or courts.
